messages.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

Short answer: In a radar-related Aerospace / Defense workflow, a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits on the communications / OTA / NTN side of the system test, not as the radar-target or radar-echo simulator itself [12][17][20].
| Workflow area | Where the tester fits | Relevant R&S context | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Radar function / target simulation | Use a radar-specific instrument rather than a wireless signaling tester. | R&S AREG800A is an Automotive Radar Echo Generator for dynamic artificial object generation.[17] | The AREG800A supports hybrid or digital echo generation for radar under test, with distances up to 3000 m in the cited specifications.[20] |
| Communications link around the radar platform | Use a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester to validate wireless connectivity, signaling behavior, RF measurements, and OTA behavior of the radio subsystem. | R&S CMX500 OBT is described as a one-box signaling tester for 4G, 5G NR and WLAN OTA tests.[12] | R&S CMX500 OBT is used with Bluetest RTS and Bluetest Flow v1.18 for 4G, 5G NR and WLAN over-the-air tests.[11] |
| OTA chamber / antenna measurement workflow | Place the CMX500 OBT inside the OTA signaling test chain controlled by partner chamber software. | MVG integrated R&S CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite so MVG antenna measurement systems can run 5G NR and LTE OTA signaling testing.[32] | MVG multiprobe systems with CMX500 OBT support 5G NR, RedCap, LTE and WLAN OTA signaling workflows at PR / solution level.[44] |
| NTN / satellite-connected defense communications | Use CMX500 for NTN device or link emulation / validation, not for radar echo generation. | R&S CMX500 is positioned as an NTN one-box tester supporting NR-NTN, NB-NTN and Direct-to-Cell testing on one platform.[6] | In an MWC 2024 NTN-NR demo, R&S CMX500 OBT simulated a satellite base station, while R&S SMBV100B simulated satellite constellations with its GNSS option.[15] |
【推論】For an Aerospace / Defense radar platform, the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester would most defensibly be placed after or alongside radar performance testing, to test the platform’s wireless links, OTA behavior, cellular/WLAN/NTN connectivity, and application-layer radio performance, while radar echo/target simulation remains the role of radar-specific equipment such as AREG800A.[12][15][17][20][44]
【推論】If the use case is counter-UAV or surveillance, radar may handle detection/tracking, while the CMX500-type tester would address any 4G/5G/WLAN/NTN communications subsystem rather than the radar sensor itself.[52][12][44]

Short answer: In a radar-related Aerospace / Defense workflow, a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits on the communications / OTA / NTN side of the system test, not as the radar-target or radar-echo simulator itself [12][17][20].
| Workflow area | Where the tester fits | Relevant R&S context | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Radar function / target simulation | Use a radar-specific instrument rather than a wireless signaling tester. | R&S AREG800A is an Automotive Radar Echo Generator for dynamic artificial object generation.[17] | The AREG800A supports hybrid or digital echo generation for radar under test, with distances up to 3000 m in the cited specifications.[20] |
| Communications link around the radar platform | Use a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester to validate wireless connectivity, signaling behavior, RF measurements, and OTA behavior of the radio subsystem. | R&S CMX500 OBT is described as a one-box signaling tester for 4G, 5G NR and WLAN OTA tests.[12] | R&S CMX500 OBT is used with Bluetest RTS and Bluetest Flow v1.18 for 4G, 5G NR and WLAN over-the-air tests.[11] |
| OTA chamber / antenna measurement workflow | Place the CMX500 OBT inside the OTA signaling test chain controlled by partner chamber software. | MVG integrated R&S CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite so MVG antenna measurement systems can run 5G NR and LTE OTA signaling testing.[32] | MVG multiprobe systems with CMX500 OBT support 5G NR, RedCap, LTE and WLAN OTA signaling workflows at PR / solution level.[44] |
| NTN / satellite-connected defense communications | Use CMX500 for NTN device or link emulation / validation, not for radar echo generation. | R&S CMX500 is positioned as an NTN one-box tester supporting NR-NTN, NB-NTN and Direct-to-Cell testing on one platform.[6] | In an MWC 2024 NTN-NR demo, R&S CMX500 OBT simulated a satellite base station, while R&S SMBV100B simulated satellite constellations with its GNSS option.[15] |
【推論】For an Aerospace / Defense radar platform, the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester would most defensibly be placed after or alongside radar performance testing, to test the platform’s wireless links, OTA behavior, cellular/WLAN/NTN connectivity, and application-layer radio performance, while radar echo/target simulation remains the role of radar-specific equipment such as AREG800A.[12][15][17][20][44]
【推論】If the use case is counter-UAV or surveillance, radar may handle detection/tracking, while the CMX500-type tester would address any 4G/5G/WLAN/NTN communications subsystem rather than the radar sensor itself.[52][12][44]

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
